backtest.name: FY19-20 slowdown / IL&FS
backtest.consensus_note: Q1FY20 GDP print of 5.0% (MoSPI, 30 Aug 2019) made the slowdown consensus; IL&FS defaulted Sep 2018
backtest.reason: Structural data miss: NSE XBRL quarterly P&L starts Q4FY18, so YoY growth exists only from Q4FY19 and the own-history percentile needs 4 more points (first usable ~Q3FY20). Balance-sheet and cash-flow XBRL start only around FY21-FY23, so the liquidity detectors could not see IL&FS-era stress at all.
